title: Workshop: build a settings panel
summary: Style a settings panel with structural, form-state, link and focus pseudo-classes, plus generated content and counters.
intro: a settings panel with a list of checkboxes, an email form and a help link. The HTML is already written (see the html tab). Every step uses a pseudo-class or a pseudo-element: structural selectors for dividers and stripes, `:checked` and `:disabled` for the form, `:hover` and `:focus-visible` for interaction, and `::before`, `::after`, `::selection` and counters for generated content. Checks cover the parts that can be checked automatically, and you can see the rest in the preview.
